ca62_clarification.sp2_onward_rule: Every SP2+ component (shim and daemon) returns unsupported_version in both directions when schema_digest is missing or mismatched before dispatching tools or sending bearer credentials.
ca62_clarification.historical_i2_wheel_rule: The frozen historical I2 wheel (5d00a88 / 972ae5a / 035a4cd) enforces the 4-key /v2/identity contract and therefore emits (code='identity_mismatch', bearer_sent=0, dispatches=0) against an SP2 daemon; this observed cross-version baseline is preserved verbatim.

scope_and_survey_rulings.sp2_execution_scope: Execute SP2-0 and SP2-1 on I2 transport (035a4cd) with independent test author, RED receipt, reseal review, implementation, GREEN + full gate, isolated behavioral mutation verification, and independent 11-lens review; pause cleanly after SP2-1 waiting for SP1 Increment 3 (store=5, policy=4) merge before SP2-2..5.
scope_and_survey_rulings.o2_o9_survey_sources: Official documentation, verified repo records (T0/R56/D8 035a4cd), and read-only CLI --version/--help outputs only; zero access to live user transcripts or live ~/.claude/~/.codex configurations; unverified fields recorded as unknown and unemitted events as unavailable.

owner_decision_records.question: Baseline, spec rev 22, §7.4/ca 62 clarification, and sync untracked plan/review/skill files
owner_decision_records.answer: (Recommended) Xác nhận baseline 035a4cd + spec rev 22 + câu làm rõ §7.4/ca 62 (SP2 trở đi trả unsupported_version cả 2 chiều; wheel I2 đóng băng giữ identity_mismatch, bearer_sent=0, dispatches=0), lưu biên bản quyết định vào docs/reviews/ và đồng bộ các file plan/review/skill chưa commit từ repo chính vào nhánh này

owner_decision_records.question: SP2 execution boundary prior to I3 (store=5, policy=4) merge
owner_decision_records.answer: (Recommended) Chạy trọn SP2-0 → SP2-1 trên nền transport I2 (035a4cd) theo đúng thứ tự plan (có test author độc lập, RED/GREEN/mutation, reseal và independent review 11 lens), sau đó dừng sạch chờ I3 merge (store=5, policy=4) trước khi mở store v6/policy v5 ở SP2-2..5
